notes.title: Minor Gameplay Adjustments and Bug Fixes Update Log - 2025.09.14 v1.0.4A
notes.notes:
Good Sunday, Your Majesty. We have implemented some further updates and fixes to the game. Details are as follows:
[olist]
Bug fixes.

The effect of the "Celestial Mandate" event will now be removed upon entering Endless Mode.

Slightly increased clearance rewards on certain difficulty levels.

Added a new low-difficulty mode, accessible via the leftmost button in the difficulty tab on the mode selection screen.

Adjusted certain sound effects.
[/olist][p align="start"]Happy weekend!

notes.title: Minor Gameplay Adjustments and Bug Fixes Update Log - 2025.09.13 v1.03B
notes.notes:
Good afternoon, Your Majesty. We have implemented further updates and fixes to the game. Details are as follows:
[olist]
Bug fixes.

Changed the numerical color of card corner icons—each stacking value now has a unique color indicator.

Reduced the difficulty of certain crisis challenges.

Adjusted the appearance rates of certain cards and policies—higher-quality cards and policies are now more likely to appear.

Added additional sound effects.
[/olist][p align="start"]We hope you enjoy the game! You are also cordially invited to join our Discord to discuss court affairs together!

notes.title: Minor Gameplay Adjustments and Bug Fixes - 2025.09.12
notes.notes:
Dear Your Majesty,

We have made some adjustments to the gameplay and fixed known bugs. The update details are as follows:
[olist]
Fixed several bugs and mechanics that affected gameplay.

Adjusted icons for certain units.

Clearing stage "New Policy Dawns" now rewards 1 \[Ballad of Triumph].

Increased the efficiency of \[Ballad of Triumph] generation when \[Imperial Concubine] removes units.

Increased the chance for the \[Seven Stars] Reform to generate \[Ballad of Triumph].

Raised the maximum attempts of card rerolls allowed per turn.

Adjusted the cost curve for rerolling cards, now making it cheaper.

Increased the effect multiplier of the Zodiac Loong on cards of corresponding tiers.

Randomly generated Zodiac signs will no longer be the same as the previous one.
[/olist]
Hope you have a great time! We also sincerely invite you to join our discord and govern together!

Join Our Discord !
